capabilities.name: structures.place
capabilities.description: A saved structure's placement goes as its own region-edit op (RegionEditOp::Structure, the Paste body), which the server refuses where the world's mode lacks the `structures` ability (shared/modes/modes.json; STRUCTURES.md §9). Without it a client sends plain pastes.

capabilities.name: grid.frames
capabilities.description: The player's grid travels on the wire (docs/proposals/MOON_WORLD.md §7.2): a snapshot ends with the local player's grid (its index in shared/worldgen/grids.json, 0 the home grid) and, off home, the grid's frame (origin, rotation); the other grids' chunks arrive as ChunkData and ChunkUnload ending with their grid byte. Without it the server sends neither, and a player off home is seen at their world position.

capabilities.name: creatures.npcs
capabilities.description: A Creatures message ends with its NPCs' part (WORK_QUEUE item 38, CHARACTERS.md §11.10): per NPC its id, kind name, idle pose (stand, look, sit) and palette variant seed, from which the client picks the NPC's colours by shared/creatures/creatures.json. Without it the server leaves the part out, and an NPC is drawn as its model's plain creature.
